results.title: Moldova extradites wanted Punjab gangster Amritpal Singh to India after Red Notice
results.description: Amritpal Singh, a Red Notice subject, has been extradited from Moldova to India. He is wanted in Punjab for serious criminal cases including murder and drug offenses. The extradition followed coordination between Indian agencies and Moldovan authorities. Singh was apprehended near the Moldova border after an Interpol Red Notice was issued. He will now face multiple criminal charges registered against him in Punjab.

results.title: Jarange Patil to begin indefinite hunger strike in Mumbai from Sept 19
results.description: Activist Manoj Jarange announced an indefinite hunger strike in Mumbai from September 19 for Maratha reservation in jobs and education. He will lead a march from September 15, covering various districts before reaching Azad Maidan. Jarange urged peaceful protest and accused the government of inaction on caste certificates, while the Bombay High Court upheld the right to protest. The core demand is for Marathas to be included in the OBC category via Kunbi records, a move opposed by existing OBC groups.
